name: HomeWalk
summary:
No treadmill? Walk your home.

HomeWalk reads your Quest's Space Setup, plans a loop of long, straight lines around your furniture and lays a light path on your real floor. You see your home the whole time, in passthrough.

While you walk, a screen stays in front of you: a simple browser with six tiles for the sites you choose, for shows, podcasts, news or your inbox. Time, distance, speed, step and calorie estimates are on screen, with a chime at every kilometer (or mile). Levels, badges, daily goals and a
